# Reviewed Rust public API shape. Generated by `just binding snapshot-update`.

pub struct AdapterSnapshot {
    pub state: AdapterState,
    pub scan_authorization: AuthorizationState,
    pub connection_authorization: AuthorizationState,
    pub name: Option<String>,
}

pub enum AdapterState {
    Unknown,
    Unavailable,
    PoweredOff,
    PoweredOn,
}

pub struct AdvertisementObservation {
    pub scan_session_id: ScanSessionId,
    pub peripheral_id: PeripheralId,
    pub local_name: Option<String>,
    pub advertised_services: Vec<BluetoothUuid>,
    pub manufacturer_data: Vec<ManufacturerData>,
    pub service_data: Vec<ServiceData>,
    pub rssi: Option<i16>,
    pub connectable: Option<bool>,
}

pub enum AndroidScanMode {
    LowPower,
    Balanced,
    LowLatency,
    Opportunistic,
}

pub struct AndroidScanOptions {
    pub scan_mode: Option<AndroidScanMode>,
    pub phy: Option<AndroidScanPhy>,
    pub report_delay_ms: Option<u32>,
    pub legacy: Option<bool>,
}

pub enum AndroidScanPhy {
    Le1m,
    Le2m,
    LeCoded,
}

pub struct AssociateCompanionDeviceCommand {
    pub command_id: CommandId,
    pub service_uuids: Vec<BluetoothUuid>,
    pub display_name: Option<String>,
    pub device_profile: Option<String>,
    pub notify_on_device_nearby: bool,
}

pub enum AuthorizationState {
    NotRequired,
    NotDetermined,
    Denied,
    Restricted,
    Authorized,
}

pub const BLEHUB_CONTRACT_VERSION: u32 = 7;

pub struct BackendAssembly;

impl BackendAssembly {
    pub fn new(downstream: Arc<dyn BleEventSink>) -> Self;
    pub fn ticket(&self) -> u64;
    pub fn finish(mut self) -> Result<Arc<BleHub>, BleHubError>;
}

pub struct BackendCapabilities {
    pub platform: Platform,
    pub contract_version: u32,
    pub supports_duplicate_scan_results: bool,
    pub supports_connectable_flag: bool,
    pub supports_read_rssi: bool,
    pub supports_required_notification: bool,
    pub supports_required_indication: bool,
    pub reports_actual_notification_mode: bool,
}

impl BackendCapabilities {
    pub fn new(platform: Platform) -> Self;
}

pub struct BackendEventIngressHandle;

impl BackendEventIngressHandle {
    pub fn push(&self, event: BleEvent) -> EventIngressStatus;
}

pub trait BleBackend: Send + Sync {
    fn capabilities(&self) -> Result<BackendCapabilities, BleHubError>;
    fn bind_event_ingress(&self, ingress: Arc<BackendEventIngressHandle>,) -> Result<(), BleHubError>;
    fn initialize(&self, command: InitializeCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn set_adapter_enabled(&self, command: SetAdapterEnabledCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn query_devices(&self, command: QueryDevicesCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn associate_companion_device(&self, command: AssociateCompanionDeviceCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn start_scan(&self, command: StartScanCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn stop_scan(&self, command: StopScanCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn connect(&self, command: ConnectCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn disconnect(&self, command: DisconnectCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn discover_gatt(&self, command: DiscoverGattCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn read_characteristic(&self, command: ReadCharacteristicCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn write_characteristic(&self, command: WriteCharacteristicCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn read_descriptor(&self, command: ReadDescriptorCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn write_descriptor(&self, command: WriteDescriptorCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn set_notifications(&self, command: SetNotificationsCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn read_rssi(&self, command: ReadRssiCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn mtu(&self, command: MtuCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn set_connection_priority(&self, command: SetConnectionPriorityCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn create_bond(&self, command: CreateBondCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn remove_bond(&self, command: RemoveBondCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn refresh_gatt_cache(&self, command: RefreshGattCacheCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn cancel_operation(&self, request: CancelOperationRequest) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    fn dispose(&self) -> Result<(), BleHubError>;
}

pub enum BleErrorCategory {
    Permission,
    AdapterUnavailable,
    InvalidState,
    NotFound,
    Timeout,
    Cancelled,
    OperationAborted,
    Connection,
    Gatt,
    Protocol,
    NotSupported,
    Backend,
    Internal,
}

pub enum BleEvent {
    AdapterSnapshotChanged {command_id: Option<CommandId>, snapshot: AdapterSnapshot,},
    ScanStarted {command_id: CommandId, scan_id: ScanSessionId,},
    AdvertisementObserved {advertisement: AdvertisementObservation,},
    ScanStopped {scan_id: ScanSessionId, result: ScanStopResult,},
    ConnectionStateChanged {command_id: Option<CommandId>, connection_id: ConnectionId, result: ConnectionStateResult,},
    GattDiscovered {command_id: CommandId, database: GattDatabase,},
    CharacteristicRead {command_id: CommandId, connection_id: ConnectionId, gatt_session_id: GattSessionId, characteristic_id: GattCharacteristicId, value: Vec<u8>,},
    CharacteristicWritten {command_id: CommandId, connection_id: ConnectionId, gatt_session_id: GattSessionId, characteristic_id: GattCharacteristicId,},
    DescriptorRead {command_id: CommandId, connection_id: ConnectionId, gatt_session_id: GattSessionId, characteristic_id: GattCharacteristicId, descriptor_id: GattDescriptorId, value: Vec<u8>,},
    DescriptorWritten {command_id: CommandId, connection_id: ConnectionId, gatt_session_id: GattSessionId, characteristic_id: GattCharacteristicId, descriptor_id: GattDescriptorId,},
    NotificationStateChanged {command_id: CommandId, connection_id: ConnectionId, gatt_session_id: GattSessionId, subscription_id: SubscriptionId, characteristic_id: GattCharacteristicId, state: NotificationState,},
    NotificationReceived {connection_id: ConnectionId, gatt_session_id: GattSessionId, subscription_id: SubscriptionId, characteristic_id: GattCharacteristicId, value: Vec<u8>,},
    RssiRead {command_id: CommandId, connection_id: ConnectionId, rssi: i16,},
    MtuRead {command_id: CommandId, connection_id: ConnectionId, info: MtuInfo,},
    DevicesListed {command_id: CommandId, devices: Vec<DeviceRecord>,},
    CompanionPresenceChanged {present: bool, key: String, local_name: Option<String>,},
    BondStateChanged {command_id: Option<CommandId>, connection_id: ConnectionId, state: BondState,},
    CommandCompleted {command_id: CommandId, error: Option<BleEventError>,},
    BackendError {error: BleEventError,},
}

impl BleEvent {
    pub fn command_id(&self) -> Option<CommandId>;
}

pub struct BleEventError {
    pub category: BleErrorCategory,
    pub message: String,
    pub platform_details: Option<Box<PlatformErrorDetails>>,
}

pub trait BleEventSink: Send + Sync {
    fn on_event(&self, event: BleEvent) -> Result<(), EventSinkError>;
}

pub struct BleHub;

impl BleHub {
    pub fn new(backend: Arc<dyn BleBackend>, downstream: Arc<dyn BleEventSink>,) -> Result<Arc<Self>, BleHubError>;
    pub fn capabilities(&self) -> BackendCapabilities;
    pub fn initialize(&self, command: InitializeCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn set_adapter_enabled(&self, command: SetAdapterEnabledCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn query_devices(&self, command: QueryDevicesCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn associate_companion_device(&self, command: AssociateCompanionDeviceCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn start_scan(&self, command: StartScanCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn stop_scan(&self, command: StopScanCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn connect(&self, command: ConnectCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn disconnect(&self, command: DisconnectCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn discover_gatt(&self, command: DiscoverGattCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn read_characteristic(&self, command: ReadCharacteristicCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn write_characteristic(&self, command: WriteCharacteristicCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn read_descriptor(&self, command: ReadDescriptorCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn write_descriptor(&self, command: WriteDescriptorCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn set_notifications(&self, command: SetNotificationsCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn read_rssi(&self, command: ReadRssiCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn mtu(&self, command: MtuCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn set_connection_priority(&self, command: SetConnectionPriorityCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn create_bond(&self, command: CreateBondCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn remove_bond(&self, command: RemoveBondCommand) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn refresh_gatt_cache(&self, command: RefreshGattCacheCommand,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn cancel_operation(&self, target_command_id: crate::CommandId,) -> Result<(), CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn dispose(&self) -> Result<(), BleHubError>;
}

pub enum BleHubError {
    BackendAssembly {detail: String},
    BackendCleanup {detail: String, platform_details: Option<Box<PlatformErrorDetails>>,},
    ResourceBusy {detail: String},
    InvalidConfiguration {field: String, detail: String},
    FfiContract {detail: String},
}

pub struct BluetoothUuid {
    pub value: String,
}

impl BluetoothUuid {
    pub fn canonicalize(value: &str) -> Option<Self>;
}

pub enum BondState {
    None,
    Bonding,
    Bonded,
}

pub struct CancelOperationRequest {
    pub target_command_id: CommandId,
}

pub struct CharacteristicProperties {
    pub readable: bool,
    pub writable_with_response: bool,
    pub writable_without_response: bool,
    pub notifiable: bool,
    pub indicatable: bool,
}

pub enum CommandDispatchError {
    Closed,
    InvalidRequest {detail: String},
    InvalidState {detail: String},
    OperationNotFound {target_command_id: super::CommandId},
    OperationAlreadyCompleted {target_command_id: super::CommandId},
    OperationNotCancellable {target_command_id: super::CommandId},
    ResourceExhausted {detail: String},
    BackendUnavailable {detail: String, platform_details: Option<Box<PlatformErrorDetails>>,},
    NotSupported {detail: String},
    FfiContract {detail: String},
}

pub struct CommandId {
    pub value: u64,
}

pub enum CommandKind {
    Initialize,
    SetAdapterEnabled,
    QueryDevices,
    AssociateCompanionDevice,
    StartScan,
    StopScan,
    Connect,
    Disconnect,
    DiscoverGatt,
    ReadCharacteristic,
    WriteCharacteristic,
    ReadDescriptor,
    WriteDescriptor,
    SetNotifications,
    ReadRssi,
    Mtu,
    SetConnectionPriority,
    CreateBond,
    RemoveBond,
    RefreshGattCache,
}

pub struct ConnectCommand {
    pub command_id: CommandId,
    pub connection_id: ConnectionId,
    pub peripheral_id: PeripheralId,
    pub auto_connect: bool,
}

pub struct ConnectionId {
    pub value: u64,
}

pub enum ConnectionPriority {
    Balanced,
    High,
    LowPower,
}

pub enum ConnectionState {
    Connecting,
    Connected,
    Disconnecting,
    Disconnected,
}

pub enum ConnectionStateResult {
    Ok {state: ConnectionState},
    Err {error: BleEventError},
}

pub struct CreateBondCommand {
    pub command_id: CommandId,
    pub connection_id: ConnectionId,
    pub pin: Option<String>,
}

pub enum DeviceQueryKind {
    Connected,
    Bonded,
    Companion,
}

pub struct DeviceRecord {
    pub key: String,
    pub local_name: Option<String>,
    pub connected: bool,
    pub bonded: bool,
}

    pub command_id: CommandId,
    pub connection_id: ConnectionId,
}

pub struct DiscoverGattCommand {
    pub command_id: CommandId,
    pub connection_id: ConnectionId,
    pub gatt_session_id: GattSessionId,
}

pub enum EventIngressStatus {
    Delivered,
    Closed,
    InvalidEvent {message: String},
    DownstreamFailed {message: String},
}

pub enum EventSinkError {
    Rejected {detail: String},
    UnexpectedCallback {detail: String},
}

    pub value: u64,
}

    pub value: u64,

    pub value: u64,
}

    pub command_id: CommandId,
}

pub const MAX_COMPANION_PROFILE_BYTES: usize = 128;

pub const MAX_LOCAL_NAME_BYTES: usize = 248;

pub const MAX_MTU: u16 = 517;

pub const MAX_SCAN_REPORT_DELAY_MS: u32 = 5000;

pub const MAX_WRITE_VALUE_BYTES: usize = 512;

pub const MIN_MTU: u16 = 23;

pub struct ManufacturerData {
    pub company_id: u16,
    pub payload: Vec<u8>,
}

pub struct ManufacturerDataFilter {
    pub company_id: u16,
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
    pub mask: Option<Vec<u8>>,
}

pub struct MtuCommand {
    pub command_id: CommandId,
    pub connection_id: ConnectionId,
    pub request: Option<u16>,
}

pub struct MtuInfo {
    pub mtu: Option<u16>,
    pub maximum_write_with_response: Option<u16>,
    pub maximum_write_without_response: Option<u16>,
}

pub enum NotificationAction {
    Enable {mode: NotificationModeRequest},
    Disable,
}

pub enum NotificationMode {
    Notification,
    Indication,
}

pub enum NotificationModeRequest {
    PlatformDefault,
    RequireNotification,
    RequireIndication,
}

pub enum NotificationState {
    Enabled {actual_mode: Option<NotificationMode>,},
    Disabled,
}

pub struct PeripheralId {
    pub value: u64,
}

pub enum Platform {
    Windows,
    Android,
    Apple,
    Linux,
    Test,
}

    pub platform: Platform,
    pub code: Option<String>,
    pub name: Option<String>,

    pub status: Option<i32>,
    pub att_code: Option<i32>,
}

pub struct ScanOptions {
    pub service_uuids: Vec<BluetoothUuid>,
    pub name_prefix: Option<String>,
    pub exact_name: Option<String>,
    pub company_id: Option<u16>,
    pub min_rssi: Option<i16>,
    pub manufacturer_data: Option<ManufacturerDataFilter>,
    pub android: Option<AndroidScanOptions>,
    pub allow_duplicates: bool,
}

impl ScanOptions {
    pub fn validated(mut self) -> Result<Self, CommandDispatchError>;
    pub fn matches(&self, observation: &AdvertisementObservation) -> bool;
}

pub struct ScanSessionId {
    pub value: u64,
}

pub enum ScanStopReason {
    Requested {command_id: CommandId},
    SystemSuspended,
}

pub enum ScanStopResult {
    Ok {reason: ScanStopReason},
    Err {error: BleEventError},
}

pub struct ServiceData {
    pub service_uuid: BluetoothUuid,
    pub payload: Vec<u8>,
}

    pub command_id: CommandId,
    pub enabled: bool,
}

    pub connection_id: ConnectionId,

}

    pub connection_id: ConnectionId,

    pub characteristic_id: GattCharacteristicId,

    pub value: u64,
}

pub struct WriteCharacteristicCommand {
    pub command_id: CommandId,
    pub connection_id: ConnectionId,
    pub gatt_session_id: GattSessionId,
    pub characteristic_id: GattCharacteristicId,
    pub value: Vec<u8>,
    pub write_type: WriteType,
}

pub struct WriteDescriptorCommand {
    pub command_id: CommandId,
    pub connection_id: ConnectionId,
    pub gatt_session_id: GattSessionId,
    pub characteristic_id: GattCharacteristicId,
    pub descriptor_id: GattDescriptorId,
    pub value: Vec<u8>,
}

pub enum WriteType {
    WithResponse,
    WithoutResponse,
}
